blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte remained tight-lipped on Thursday about her possible participation in her impeachment trial. “Merry Christmas to all of you,” Duterte said when reporters initially tried to get a statement from her after the Senate quickly moved to consider the proposed P787.2 million budget of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) for 2027. She declined to respond when reporters repeatedly asked whether she would attend her trial, which is set to resume next week. Her defense team has already started presenting evidence before the Senate impeachment court to counter the prosecution’s allegations that she amassed […]...
